# FX-013 Full-Folder Fixture

`sanitized-real/` is the deterministic, sanitized structural copy of the accepted ten-file local source. `populated/` is a separate deterministic supplement that covers participant shapes absent from that sparse source. Neither directory contains live source values, credentials, player identifiers, server identifiers, host names, world names, timestamps, or extension jars.

`fixture-manifest.json` is the authoritative inventory. `manifest.sha256` pins its bytes. The supported legacy source is the current ReSync and Remotely heads declared in the Gate 0A compatibility matrix.
